scope: Chromium browser-event software controls, not real OS IME/hardware certification, all-browser conformance, language recognition or scientific accuracy

baseline.description: All dispatched IME Enter defaults were prevented. Captured original traces show one actual message POST in each standard/229 case and a shortcut dialog in the slash case.

capturedEvidence.origin: Playwright captured original implementation failure traces; only request counts and dialog presence extracted, not browser credentials

checks: IME Enter leaves native default available, emits no message POST, keeps draft and full stored version
Next ordinary Enter sends exactly once; parse/report unchanged and saved version survives reload
Composing slash opens no dialog; ordinary slash still opens original shortcuts
Shift Enter preserves newline, Ctrl/Meta Enter do not send, explicit button sends original multiline question once
Existing readiness, separate project/version drafts and stop flows pass
historicalProofPolicy: Keep old fingerprints and labels unchanged; compare changed implementations with genuine earlier byte-verified source.
